integrity: Finite exact enumeration in two graph representations, a fully specified adjacency predicate, an explicit isomorphism, a replayed optimal-state certificate and a symmetry/shortest-path check. Not externally certified.
scientific_limitations: The finite claim is restricted to the 20-vertex Desargues graph; no extension to other bipartite Kneser graphs follows. Some earlier relevant publications could only be inspected partly; possible unindexed overlap remains. The numerical classification is reproducible by finite exhaustive checking, not a proof of a universal formula.
title: Two spare guards suffice for optimal secure-domination reconfiguration in the Desargues graph
